visible smooth freeform envelope and reflection-line continuity

decision: Preserve the high-fidelity master and manufacturing meshes. Reopen optimization only after an exact slicer/profile baseline exists.
required_next_evidence: Exact Anycubic machine, process, TPU filament, and orientation profiles
Baseline slice metrics: time, layers, model/support material, retractions, warnings, and peak flow
Three isolated A/B/C candidates sliced under comparable conditions

limitations: Triangle count and file size are not proxies for print time or deposited material.
No strength, fatigue, comfort, or wear claim is made without process-matched physical evidence.
